official_address: 上海市徐汇区延庆路159号
street_verification: Plate 189 visibly places the green numbered street plate alongside the municipal Heritage Architecture plate for 159 Yanqing Road. Both plates 189 and 190 follow the paragraph specific to number 159, before the separate Savoy Apartments paragraph.

additional_sources.evidence: Local-history article reproduces an entry for the Cuban legation at 159 Route de Grouchy, July 1934. It tentatively associates 151 Route de Grouchy in the 1925 directory with the later site.
The author recounts observing repairs in May 2020. Holly’s conspicuous row-house photograph in the same article is captioned 151–157, a different group.
Article distinguishes the large tree in the 159 garden from 121 and the adjoining houses. Its photograph of the walled alley is useful for context only.

period: Construction year pending. The road article reports 1933, but the low-resolution photographed official plate does not permit a reliable transcription of its year. The 1925 earlier-address link dates an occupant or parcel rather than necessarily the present structure. The 1934 legation listing documents use at the address.
style: The English line on the actual municipal plate reads Neoclassical style. The road article uses American country style. Neither label supplies unseen geometry.
perimeter: Individual registered residence at 159. The four attached houses 151–157 are separate, as is the Savoy/Ruihua apartment block, formerly 161 and 163 Route de Grouchy, now the Changshu Road 209 Lane group. Current garden boundary is not surveyed.
visible: The street view shows exposed grey-brown aggregate, two small circular openings at differing heights and the shadowed arched opening by the canopy, pale soffit and dark garden pier. The courtyard view shows two intersecting rendered elevations, a tall recessed arched doorway, roundel, outward-opening steel leaves, rounded/square window and sill surrounds, projecting roof fascia and short stair cheeks. One partial leaf and part of the eaves are covered by cables and canopies.
limits: No interiors or opposite garden elevation measured. No full roof plan, absolute eaves height or complete footprint inferred from these two views. Photo 77 of the street and garden trees does not support facade measurements.
image_rights: Published photographs are reference-only. No inferred permission to redistribute the images. Only numeric readings and independently drawn textures are intended for repository publication.
